title: Prophet's Prayers for Protection
summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) prayed for protection against discord, hypocrisy, and bad character.
translation: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) sought refuge from several things, which is a significant matter. In examining his prayers, you will notice many include supplications for protection. For example, one prayer is: 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from discord, hypocrisy, and bad character.' This shows these three traits should not be in a person. Therefore, the Prophet prayed that these should never exist within him, neither causing discord nor possessing hypocrisy or bad character. Hypocrisy has many forms, whether in belief, action, or speech. The Prophet sought protection against all forms of hypocrisy. Similarly, another prayer is: 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, lack, and humiliation, and from oppressing others or being oppressed.' These prayers by the Prophet emphasize the importance of avoiding these negative traits and seeking Allah’s protection from them. By doing so, one can develop good qualities and draw closer to Allah, and hope to achieve the companionship of the Prophet (peace be upon him). This is why these prayers and the desire to avoid negative traits should be a part of our hearts. May Allah grant us the right deeds and thoughts, and the presence of the Prophet’s comprehensive supplications.
